bias.en: Rebound fading · lost the 100-day, on the 10-day
bias.zh: 反弹减弱 · 跌破 100 日均线，位于 10 日均线

read.en: AMD fell 5.6% on Nov 16 to $504.28, trading $501.30–526.20. It is above the 10-day ($502.6) and 200-day ($424.5), and below the 5-day ($538.4), 30-day ($542.3, falling) and 100-day ($527.2). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 11, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 10 ($432.62), and RSI is 46.7.
read.zh: AMD 11月16日下跌 5.6%，收于 $504.28，盘中区间 $501.30–526.20。股价位于 10 日（$502.6）和 200 日均线（$424.5）上方，位于 5 日（$538.4）、30 日（$542.3，下行）和 100 日均线（$527.2）下方。MACD 自 11月11日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月10日起看多（$432.62），RSI 为 46.7。

read.en: The drop broke the 100-day and the $520–531 supports (Nov 13 low, Oct 26 close), now resistance; the $501.30 low held the 10-day and the Oct 22 low ($502.6). Resistance is $520–531.3, then $538.4–542.3 (5 and 30-day) and $552.9 (Nov 11 close). Support is $501.3–502.6, then $488.8 (Nov 4 close) and $468.2 (Nov 9 low). A close above $531.3 would target $538–553; below $501.3, $488.8.

r.en: Nov 13 low $520.01; Nov 16 high $526.20; 100-day average $527.2; Oct 26 close $531.28
